$comment: Shared session-clock fixture (parity audit row-03), consumed by the iOS MorseKitCheck harness, android SessionClockTest and desktop SessionClockTest. Data, not code - see CLAUDE.md's separate-ports rule. Expected values are derived from the rules in `derivation` (the iOS timer menu's documented behaviour, issue #41), not captured from any implementation.

derivation.remaining: seconds left on the session countdown, or null for an open-ended session; 0 means the clock has run out and the session ends
derivation.add: the timer menu's 'Add 5 minutes' / 'Add 1 minute': on a timed session the seconds are added to what is left; on an open-ended one they start a countdown of exactly that many seconds; a seconds value of zero or less changes nothing
derivation.subtract: the timer menu's 'Subtract 1 minute', offered only while the session is timed: what is left drops by the seconds, never below 0, and reaching 0 ends the session; an open-ended session has nothing to subtract from and stays open-ended; a seconds value of zero or less changes nothing
derivation.remove: 'Remove time limit' makes any session open-ended (remaining becomes null)
derivation.note: Derived from these rules directly, independently of any implementation.
